bio: The Bentley London is one of London's best kept secrets. Discreetly hidden in the residential area of the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea, the hotel is only moments from exclusive shopping at Chelsea's Kings Road and a stroll to Knightsbridge's world famous Harrods.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Lounge and Peridot, a light summery room with refreshing natural light and a view of neighbouring residential gardens, which is ideal setting to meet and socialise with your friends and family and experience the ritual of Traditional English Afternoon Tea.
